content: आलम्बनम् .²1 Depending on or from, hanging from. .²2 Support, prop, stay; एतदालम्बनं श्रेष्ठमेतदालम्बनं परम् <ls>Kaṭh. 2. 17</ls>. <ls>Ki. 2. 13</ls>; जातस्य नदीतीरे तस्यापि तृणस्य जन्मसाफल्यम् . यत्सलिलमज्जनाकुलजनहस्तावलम्बनं भवति .. <ls>Pt. 1. 28</ls>; sustaining, supporting; <ls>Me. 4</ls>. .²3 Receptacle, abode; <ls>U. 6. 10</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²4 Reason, cause. .²5 Base. .²6 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) That on which a रस or sentiment, as it were, hangs, person or thing with reference to which a sentiment arises, the natural and necessary connection of sentiment with the cause which excites it. The causes (विभाव) giving rise to a {%Rasa%} are classified as two:-- आलम्बन and उद्दीपन; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in the Bībhatsa sentiment stinking flesh <ab>&c.</ab> is the आलम्बन of the {%Rasa%}, and the attendant circumstances which enhance the feeling of loathing (the worms <ab>&c.</ab> in the flesh) are its उद्दीपनानि (exciters); for the other {%Rasas%} see <ls>S. D. 210-238</ls>. .²8 The mental exercise practised by the Yogin in endeavouring to bring before his thoughts the gross form of the Eternal. .²9 Silent repetition of a prayer. .²10 (With Buddhists) The five attributes of things corresponding to five senses, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} रूप, रस, गन्ध, स्पर्श and शब्द. .²11 {%Dharma%} or law corresponding to {%manas%}.
